headline: High: shared filesystem and permissive file parsing create prompt-injection, leakage, and action-conflict risks between ChatGPT Desktop and Claude Code.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps, while Claude Code reads repo files and user-provided directories. If either agent consumes the other's file output as instructions, a shared workspace or manual handoff can carry injected prompts. This is not provably blocked, but the bridge is narrower than a fully shared MCP channel.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop reads a file produced by Claude Code as trusted instructions
IF Claude Code parses ChatGPT Desktop output from a shared directory or copied file
mitigations: Keep agent outputs in separate directories
Prefix all inter-agent files with a non-executable header
Require a human to strip instructions before reuse
Use read-only exports for handoff files
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to every exchanged artifact

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents can read local files, and ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected IDE code while Claude Code can access repo files and user-provided directories. That creates a default path for sensitive data to flow into both vendors' inference backends. The profiles do not show a hard isolation boundary, so leakage is plausible in normal use.
conditions: IF the same sensitive document is opened in both agents
IF screenshots or connected IDE content include secrets and are sent to ChatGPT Desktop
IF Claude Code is pointed at a directory containing regulated data
mitigations: Restrict both agents to non-sensitive projects
Remove secrets from shared folders before use
Disable connected-IDE access for sensitive repos
Use separate OS accounts for each agent
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Claude Code can write files, modify git state, execute shell, and use MCP; ChatGPT Desktop can read filesystem and files from apps but cannot write. The pair still conflicts on the same working tree because Claude Code can mutate repo state that ChatGPT Desktop may then read and act on. Uncertainty about orchestration locking pushes this to high rather than medium.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same repository or directory
IF Claude Code commits or rewrites files while ChatGPT Desktop is reading them
mitigations: Assign each agent a separate checkout
Pause one agent before the other writes
Use git worktrees for parallel edits
Review diffs before handing off between agents
requires-engineering: add file-locking around shared workspaces

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can produce code or file-derived conclusions, and Claude Code can execute shell, modify git state, and use MCP. If Claude Code treats ChatGPT Desktop output as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade into real actions. The profiles show no built-in verification handshake, so the pathway exists in default use.
conditions: IF Claude Code applies ChatGPT Desktop output directly to shell commands or commits
IF ChatGPT Desktop's file-derived answer is used without diff or test verification
mitigations: Require a diff review step
Run tests before any commit
Ask Claude Code to restate assumptions before acting
Limit ChatGPT Desktop to analysis-only handoff notes
requires-engineering: add automated verification gates

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop handles uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected IDE code, while Claude Code handles repo files, shell environment, and git history. If regulated data is present in either workspace, the pair can route it through two separate vendors with different retention and residency terms. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so mismatch risk is material.
conditions: IF EU personal data is processed in a US-restricted workspace
IF PHI or secrets are placed into either agent's files or uploads
IF retention settings differ between the two vendors
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both tools
Use redacted copies for analysis
Confirm vendor retention settings before use
Separate compliance-sensitive projects by workspace
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA and residency review
